# Alexander T. Bell (Alec Bell)

> Personal site of Alec Bell: co-founder and CTO of ThunderPhone, which builds AI voice agents that handle real phone calls for businesses. Previously solo founder of SensorSurf (YC W23, robot-fleet data infrastructure); earlier worked on self-driving cars at Uber ATG, conversational AI at Expedia, and autonomous marine systems at Sea Machines. MS in computer science (CU Boulder, computer-vision research published at ECCV 2022), BS from Ohio State. Based in San Francisco.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alexandertbell.com/): about, current work, photos
- [Background](https://alexandertbell.com/background): job history, education, publications
- [Blog](https://alexandertbell.com/blog): occasional writing
- [Genealogy](https://alexandertbell.com/genealogy): Bell family research, traced and sourced (interactive explorer)
- [Family tree, full text](https://alexandertbell.com/family-tree): the complete tree as plain static HTML — 194 people, ahnentafel-numbered, with dates, relationships, stories, and evidence grades; start here for genealogy questions
- [Bell paternal line](https://alexandertbell.com/pedigree/bell-lineage): the Bell line as a narrative, generation by generation, static HTML
- [Bell deep-line evidence map](https://alexandertbell.com/pedigree/bell-deep-line): how each link in the deep Bell line is evidenced
- [Pedigree research view](https://alexandertbell.com/pedigree/): interactive chart with photographs and scanned evidence
- [Raw genealogy data](https://alexandertbell.com/pedigree/pedigree-data.json): machine-readable JSON of the whole tree (keys are ahnentafel numbers; n=name, d=dates, s=story, x=evidence, g=grade)
